signal: Tessell raised a $60M Series B and added Matt McDonough and Jeffrey Carter to its exec team (May 2026)

email.body1:
Charles, saw Tessell raise its $60M Series B and add Matt McDonough and Jeffrey Carter to accelerate enterprise modernization.

Scaling that fast usually means more accounts in play than the team can support before the new motion settles, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Tessell off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Charles, quick follow-up for Tessell.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Tessell needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Charles, last bit of proof for Tessell.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Tessell's reply rate likely compares to other data-platform startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Charles, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Tessell's pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The post-raise stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B data-platform motion? I'll tailor it to Tessell either way.
